criteria.timing: |d(10-90%)| <= 10% of ideal at TP5 and TP6, rise and fall
criteria.overshoot: TP5 large-step overshoot (rise and fall) <= ideal + 5 %-points
criteria.stability: pp at TP5 < 50 mV in every flat window (zero-input 200 us, -140 V, +140 V, after small step) and all edges settled to 1 % inside their window
